title: Northwind SaaS × Alpine Outdoor Co.: discovery call
attendees: Priya Nair <priya@northwind.example>, Hanna Berg <hanna@alpineoutdoor.example>, Marc Duval <marc@alpineoutdoor.example>
transcript:
Priya: Thanks both. Hanna, you mentioned support gets swamped around Black Friday?
Hanna: Completely. We have twelve agents on one shared Gmail inbox. In late November we get about three thousand emails a week.
Marc: And half of them are 'where is my order', which our Shopify store could answer by itself.
Priya: That's where our Shopify integration helps: order status shows next to the ticket, and you can send a ready answer in one click.
Hanna: Our goal is a first reply within four hours, even at peak. Today it's closer to two days.
Priya: What does the timeline look like on your side?
Marc: Budget for next year is decided in January. We'd want to be live before the spring sale in March.
Priya: Then here's what I'll do. I'll send you pricing for twelve seats and the Shopify integration one-pager by Thursday.
Hanna: Great. Can we also see it with our own kind of tickets?
Priya: Yes, I'll book a demo with our solutions engineer for next week, using sample tickets like yours.
Marc: I can export last November's ticket volumes so you can size it.
Priya: That would help, thanks Marc.
Hanna: Oh, and someone will probably ask where the data is stored. Legal might care.
Priya: Good point, we can look into that.
